inj.note: The cornerback didn't practice at all this week and will miss a second straight game after he was injured in Week 9 against the Bucs. Clark Phillips handled third cornerback duties in last Sunday's win over the Saints.

news.h: Bears rule out Gordon for second straight game due to shoulder injury
news.d: Bears cornerback Kyler Gordon's shoulder injury will prevent him from playing against the Lions in a key Thanksgiving Day divisional game in Detroit.

news.h: Bears rule out CB Kyler Gordon; RB Kyle Monangai cleared to return
news.d: The Bears will be without nickel corner Kyler Gordon when they host the Saints, while running back Kyle Monangai, wide receiver Luther Burden III and defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons are expected to play.
